payload.name: Color Card - Party Card Game
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play Color Card directly in ChatGPT and compete in a turn-based game.

Take turns playing cards of the same color or number, use action cards to change the flow of the game, and be the first to clear your hand.

Choose from three difficulty levels in the sidebar or simply tell ChatGPT which one you want.

Features:

- Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels
    
- Color- and number-based gameplay
    
- Action cards that change the flow of the game
    
- Difficulty selection from the sidebar or chat
    

Choose your challenge and start playing.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中玩 Color Card，体验回合制对战。

轮流出相同颜色或数字的牌，使用功能牌改变游戏进程，并争取率先打完手牌。

在侧边栏选择三个难度级别之一，也可以直接告诉 ChatGPT 你想玩哪个难度。

功能：

- 简单、中等和困难三个难度级别

- 基于颜色和数字的玩法

- 可改变游戏进程的功能牌

- 可在侧边栏或聊天中选择难度

选择挑战难度，开始游戏吧。

payload.name: Astera Tarot & Astrology
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore Tarot and Western astrology in ChatGPT. Astera can calculate natal charts, synastry, Solar Returns, lunar guidance, and personal horoscopes, and can draw Tarot cards and spreads. Some readings include interactive visual results. Users may optionally sign in to an existing Astera account to access features already included in their Premium entitlement. Readings are interpretive and intended for reflection or entertainment, not as medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中探索塔罗和西方占星。Astera 可以计算本命星盘、合盘、太阳返照盘、月亮指引和个人星座运势，也可以抽取塔罗牌和牌阵。部分解读包含交互式可视化结果。用户可以选择登录现有 Astera 账户，使用其 Premium 权益中已包含的功能。解读具有诠释性质，仅供自我思考或娱乐，不构成医疗、法律、财务或其他专业建议。

payload.name: OffStereo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OffStereo turns any music question into something you can hear. Ask about an artist, album, song, scene, sample, a new release, or what happened on this day in music, and OffStereo builds a short narrated show where the story and the songs play back-to-back in one player. Pause, skip, or steer it from chat; trace a track's documented samples; or spin up a playlist and listen before you save it privately to Spotify or Apple Music. Connect an OffStereo account to open your library, and link Spotify, Apple Music, or both, independently. You get a focused, relevant set of results, and OffStereo always asks before it saves to or changes your Spotify or Apple Music.
payload.longDescription: OffStereo将任何音乐问题转化为可聆听的内容。您可以询问艺术家、专辑、歌曲、音乐场景、采样、新发行作品，或是某一天的音乐历史，OffStereo会打造一个简短的有声节目，让故事与歌曲依次播放。您可通过聊天窗口暂停、跳过或控制播放，追溯某首歌曲的已记录采样，或创建播放列表并试听后再私密保存至Spotify或Apple Music。连接OffStereo账户可打开您的音乐库，并可独立绑定Spotify、Apple Music或两者皆绑定。您将获得聚焦且相关的结果，且OffStereo在保存或修改您的Spotify或Apple Music内容前始终会征得确认。

payload.name: Vidmoat

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vidmoat is an AI video editor built for agents. Tell the built-in AI what you want—or plug in Claude or Cursor—and it automatically cuts dead air, writes karaoke captions, removes backgrounds, and reframes your video for every platform.
payload.longDescription: Vidmoat 是一款专为智能体打造的 AI 视频编辑器。告诉内置 AI 你想要什么，或接入 Claude 或 Cursor，它就会自动剪掉无声片段、制作卡拉 OK 式字幕、移除背景，并为各个平台重新调整视频画面。

payload.name: Mirror Society
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mirror Society helps you prepare a persona for a small social simulation. Choose and confirm a display name, public persona summary, first-person declaration, and interaction strategy. You can also include a daily instruction and a goal for the simulation room. The app creates an onboarding profile and provides a link to continue in the Mirror Society web app, where you can join the simulation and view its results. The ChatGPT tool supports profile creation and browser handoff; it does not run simulation rounds or retrieve past results.
payload.longDescription: Mirror Society 帮助你为小型社交模拟准备一个角色。选择并确认显示名称、公开角色简介、第一人称宣言和互动策略。你还可以添加每日指令和模拟房间目标。该应用会创建一份引导资料，并提供链接，让你前往 Mirror Society 网页应用继续操作，在那里加入模拟并查看结果。ChatGPT 工具支持创建资料并交接到浏览器；它不会运行模拟轮次，也无法检索过往结果。

payload.name: Mi Basket
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Follow Uruguayan basketball from ChatGPT: the Liga Uruguaya de Basquet, the women's league, the promotion league and the youth competitions.

Ask what is being played and when, how a game ended, how the standings look, who leads a category in scoring or minutes, how a player's season is going, or how two teams have fared against each other. Every answer links back to the Mi Basket app.

If you sign in with your Mi Basket account, you can also ask about the clubs, teams and players you already follow.

Mi Basket only reads its own archive, a database we build and host. It cannot change results, your account or the teams you follow, and it sends nothing to other services.

Mi Basket is a family project: non-profit and ad-free. It is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any federation or club.
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 关注乌拉圭篮球：乌拉圭篮球联赛、女子联赛、升级联赛和青少年赛事。

可以询问正在进行什么比赛、比赛时间、赛果、积分榜情况、各类别得分或上场时间领先者、球员本赛季表现，或两支球队交手的历史情况。每个回答都会链接回 Mi Basket 应用。

使用 Mi Basket 账户登录后，还可以询问你已经关注的俱乐部、球队和球员。

payload.name: Dino Run+

Press again in the air to double jump. Collect coins, unlock six dinosaur skins, discover seasonal scenery and day/night transitions, and challenge your personal best. payload.longDescription: Play Face to Face 帮助用户发现并开始与朋友实时进行多人游戏。浏览可玩的游戏、获取推荐，并创建可分享的游戏房间，让朋友在浏览器中加入。

payload.name: SAJU

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Then keep the conversation going in plain language: personality and life path, career and wealth, love, marriage and compatibility, health, this year and next year, the best months to change jobs or move, and whether a specific day is good for a wedding, a contract or an interview — SAJU pulls the exact day pillar for any date. payload.name: 별자리 운세박사
payload.description: 免费 AI 星座与占星解读
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Free AI astrology that runs the real math. Give your birth date, time and city, and Astrology Doctor Fortune finds your zodiac signs and draws a full birth chart — Sun, Moon and Rising, all ten planets, twelve houses and every major aspect — on an interactive chart wheel you can explore right inside the chat.

Three readings in one app. Natal chart: what your zodiac placements say about your personality, your strengths and your blind spots. Horoscope: today's, this week's or any date's planetary transits read against your own chart instead of a generic sun-sign column. Compatibility: two charts overlaid for a synastry reading with mutual aspects, a match score and house overlays.

Positions are computed on the server from VSOP87D and ELP-2000 ephemeris data — the same astronomy professional astrology software runs on — with time zone and longitude correction applied automatically. Birth cities work in any language or script: Seoul or 서울, Hanoi or Hà Nội, Munich or München. Readings and chart labels come in 12 languages, including English, Korean, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Hindi, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Arabic and Vietnamese. No account, no setup, and it still works when you don't know your birth time.
payload.longDescription:
无需占星知识也能探索命盘的含义。输入出生日期、时间和城市，Astrology Doctor Fortune 就会确定你的星座并绘制完整命盘——包括太阳、月亮、上升星座、全部 10 颗行星、12 宫位和所有主要相位，并通过可在聊天中交互探索的命盘轮展示。

一个应用提供 3 种解读。出生盘：解读星盘位置所反映的个性、优势和盲点。运势：根据你的个人命盘解读今天、本周或任意日期的行星运行，而非泛泛的太阳星座专栏。合盘：叠加两张命盘进行关系解读，展示相互相位、匹配评分和宫位叠加。

行星位置在服务器上根据 VSOP87D 和 ELP-2000 星历数据计算——专业占星软件使用的同类天文数据——并自动进行时区和经度校正。出生城市支持任何语言或文字，例如 Seoul 或 서울、Hanoi 或 Hà Nội、Munich 或 München。解读和命盘标签支持 12 种语言，包括英语、韩语、繁体中文和简体中文、日语、印地语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、德语、法语、阿拉伯语和越南语。无需账号或设置；即使不知道出生时间也能使用。

payload.name: Tarotap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tarotap lets you draw real tarot cards without leaving ChatGPT. Ask a question, and Tarotap shuffles a full 78-card Rider-Waite-Smith deck on its server and fans it out face down in an interactive widget. You pick your own cards by hand, each one flips face up as it lands, and once the last card is revealed ChatGPT interprets the reading in the context of your question.

Nothing is decided in advance: cards can land upright or reversed, and they stay hidden from everyone, ChatGPT included, until you flip them. Choose from 14 classic spreads such as Time Flow (past, present, future) and the Celtic Cross, or ask for a free-form draw of one to ten cards, including a quick card of the day.

No account or sign-in is needed, and Tarotap stores nothing about you or your reading. Just ask for a reading and draw.
payload.longDescription:
Tarotap 让你无需离开 ChatGPT 就能抽取真实塔罗牌。提出问题后，Tarotap 会在服务器上洗一副完整的 78 张 Rider-Waite-Smith 塔罗牌，并在交互式组件中将牌面朝下展开。你可以亲自挑选牌；每张牌落定后都会翻开，最后一张揭晓后，ChatGPT 会结合你的问题解读牌阵。

结果不会预先决定：牌可能正位或逆位，在你翻开之前，所有人都看不到牌面，ChatGPT 也不例外。你可以从 14 种经典牌阵中选择，例如时间流（过去、现在、未来）和凯尔特十字，也可以自由抽取 1 到 10 张牌，包括快速抽取每日一牌。

无需账户或登录，Tarotap 不会存储任何关于你或占卜的信息。只需提出占卜请求并抽牌即可。

payload.name: 마이스코어봇
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
특정 날짜의 스포츠 경기 데이터를 인터랙티브 위젯으로 즉시 불러와 제공하는 서비스입니다. 정확한 스포츠 데이터에 기반한 할루시네이션 없는 답변을 보장합니다. 오직 정확한 데이터에 기반한 답변만을 제공받게 되며, 이를 통해 ChatGPT와 본 서비스에 대해 더 높은 신뢰를 가질 수 있습니다.
현재 야구, 농구, 축구, 배구 데이터를 제공하며 확대 예정입니다.

1. 할루시네이션 방지 및 신뢰도 향상: 실시간 데이터를 직접 참조하여 정확한 답변을 생성합니다. 근거 없는 정보가 아닌, 팩트에 기반한 고품질의 응답을 경험할 수 있습니다.
2. 데이터 기반의 심층 추론 제공: 단순한 스코어 전달을 넘어 실시간 경기 상황, 팀 간 전력 비교, 선수별 세부 스탯 등 풍부한 데이터를 바탕으로 사용자에게 한 차원 높은 분석을 제공합니다.
3. 인터랙티브 위젯 연동: 각 스포츠 경기 데이터를 시각적 위젯으로 가져와, 텍스트만으로는 전달하기 힘든 복잡한 스포츠 정보를 직관적으로 확인하게 합니다.

payload.name: K-Fortune 사주
payload.description: 基于四柱命理的自我探索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
K-Fortune brings Korea's traditional Four Pillars (Saju) system to ChatGPT — built by the team behind the #1 Saju custom GPT on the GPT Store, used by over 4 million people.

Enter your birth date, time, and birth city — searchable from 160,000+ cities worldwide in any language — and instantly receive your full chart in a clean interactive card: Four Pillars (사주팔자), Five Elements balance, Ten Gods, Major Fortune cycles (대운), and Annual & Monthly Fortune.

What sets K-Fortune apart is True Solar Time correction: your Hour Pillar is calculated from the sun's actual position at your birthplace, not standard clock time — the method traditionally regarded as the most rigorous in Myeongrihak (명리학). Solar-term boundaries are resolved to the exact minute, so charts born near a seasonal transition stay accurate.

Explore your elemental balance, personality patterns, career and relationship themes, or the year ahead — as a framework for self-reflection rooted in centuries of Korean tradition. K-Fortune is a personal reflection app.

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

RealAI doesn't just describe properties and places — it scores and ranks them. Every area and building carries normalized national and local benchmarks across hundreds of attributes, so RealAI can rank an entire population — markets, neighborhoods, or buildings — against any combination of criteria a user cares about, rather than profiling one place at a time off a fixed template.

payload.name: Deglaze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Deglaze brings your recipe library into ChatGPT, turning it into a cooking assistant that starts from what you and your household actually cook. It connects your Deglaze account — saved recipes (from websites, social media, cookbooks, etc.), meal plan, grocery list, household food preferences, and cooking history — so recipe suggestions reflect your real tastes and constraints.

Ask for dinner ideas and get recipes from your own library, or branch out with new recipes from Deglaze's discovery database and save the keepers to your library. Browse results as recipe cards with photos, tap through to the full recipe, or create a new recipe in the conversation from family favorites, ingredients you mention, or an idea ChatGPT helps develop.

Then turn ideas into action: put recipes on your meal plan, add their ingredients to your grocery list while skipping items you tell it to omit, and manage the list as you shop. Deglaze uses your preferences and cooking history to steer around allergies, lean into the flavors your household likes, and suggest meals without repeating recent dinners.

Free reference tools provide Liftoscript syntax, examples, program design guidance, built-in programs, and exercise names.

Private account tools require the user to authenticate with Liftosaur and have an active subscription before reading or changing programs, history, gyms, equipment, exercise settings, or measurements.
payload.longDescription:
Liftosaur 是一款可编程训练应用，使用名为“Liftoscript”的语言定义训练。该插件允许用户编写和管理 Liftoscript 程序、训练历史、动作、健身房器材、测量数据等。

私有账户工具要求用户向 Liftosaur 完成身份验证并拥有有效订阅，之后才能读取或修改训练计划、历史、健身房、器材、动作设置或测量数据。

Mention @REMAX Turkiye and tell it what you need — a three-bedroom apartment in a gated complex in Ataşehir, or a detached house near the coast in İzmir. The app reads your location, budget, room count and other preferences, then returns the listings that match.
